label: ElevenLabs Access
description: Connect ElevenLabs for the project's audio, image and video calls, with the built-in connection or your own API key (voice creation, voice agents, images, video and Flows templates need your own). Wire its access output into every ElevenLabs node.

steps: Open elevenlabs.io, Settings > API Keys, and create an API key.
Paste it below and name the connection.

permissions.label: Voice creation
permissions.description: Clone, design or remix voices. A minted voice lives in the connected account and counts against its voice slots.

steps: Voices you clone, design or remix land in the connected ElevenLabs account, so these nodes need your own account (any paid tier adds voice slots).
Nothing to pre-create: connect your own API key and the Clone Voice, Design Voice and Remix Voice nodes mint voices straight into your Voice Lab.
Manage or delete minted voices at elevenlabs.io/app/voice-lab.

permissions.label: Voice agents
permissions.description: Phone/voice agents: the agents, their phone numbers, and their call history live in the connected account.

steps: Agents, phone numbers, and conversations live in the connected ElevenLabs account, so the agent nodes need your own account.
Create an agent at elevenlabs.io/app/agents (or with the Create Agent node) and give it a voice, a prompt, and a first message.
For phone calls, import a number under Agents > Phone Numbers (Twilio or a SIP trunk) and assign it to the agent.
Optional: design or clone a custom voice first (Voice creation above) and pick it as the agent's voice.

permissions.label: Images and video
permissions.description: Generate images and videos, and run Flows templates, paid from the connected account's credits.

steps: Check that your ElevenLabs plan is Pro or above: the API refuses image and video calls below it.
Under Settings > API Keys, create a key with the Image & Video permission, or add that permission to the key you use.
On an Enterprise workspace, every image and video model starts switched off: an admin turns on each one you use under Workspace settings > Model Approvals.
The ByteDance models (Seedance, Seedream) are refused until ElevenLabs approves your workspace; ask ElevenLabs support for access. Seedance is not offered in the United States.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into an ElevenLabs node's account input.
